Name: AT - Asters Buildable Kitchen Retextures
Author: peachitto
Description:
this mod retextures the items from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11950]Asters Buildable Kitchen for Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿ using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. so you will need a few other mods in addition to this one in order for it to work! please check the mod page for the buildable kitchen to see all the requirements. [b]if you do not have the buildable kitchen mod and [i]all its requirements[/i] installed, [i]and[/i] Alternative Textures, this mod will not work!!! [/b]
and please direct any questions not directly related to [i]this retexture[/i] to that mod page, as i did not code the buildable kitchen mod so i can not help you. ok thank you!!

all that said i have not really played with the buildable kitchen mod myself, as i made this mod for a request. it seems to be working just fine but do let me know if the retextures are not working in some way.

a guide:
[list]
[*]install all required mods listed on the buildable kitchen mod page (Asters Buildable Kitchen, Dynamic Game Assets [which requires SpaceCore], Content Patcher, Alternative Textures, Mail Framework Mod)
[*]choose which set(s) you want to download. currently there is one that matches [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13294]my Barfyscorpion Set[/url]﻿ and one that matches [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12941]my Kitchen Redone[/url]. you can download one or both. or none! ...but why are you here?
[*]you buy the kitchen pieces and the paint bucket needed to recolor them from Robin
[*]mentioning because it confused me at first: the Kitchen Cabinet item has 4 rotations (like a chair) and each rotation is a different texture. there can be multiple choices for each rotation's texture.
[/list]

one more note - i modified the textures in addition to adding some new ones for the Barfyscorpion Matching set. due to the nature of the buildable kitchen mod and how flexible it's meant to be i tried to make the textures as seamless as possible. there are 2 pieces that are meant to be used on the left and right ends, though. i didn't do a perfect job and could easily make like 20+ combinations of counters for ultimate flexibility but i'm not insane enough yet.
the textures for the Kitchen Redone set are unchanged from their source so they are not as versatile. but i figured i'd just include the set as an option since i was doing it anyway.

you don't need to download both files - just the one(s) you want! i just put them both in main files because i still don't know what i'm doing. (sidenote, does that mean i need to do something different with the update keys? i don't know! they're sharing one atm)

oh and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10932]the windows in the previews are by IdaIda[/url]﻿!
